Quick asks from our side so we can finish offer copy and the private offer flow in AWS:
- Confirm preferred trial period for enterprise pilots (30/45/90 days) — we recommend 30 for initial co-sell pilots, but happy to align.
- Confirm PO flow and contacts (PO number + AP email).
- Any required phrasing for payment terms or invoicing you need in the AWS private offer / landing page.
- Any procurement redlines we should expect (e.g., data residency wording, indemnity caps).

If procurement prefers, we can produce a 1-page procurement-friendly summary specifically for the AWS private offer (I can draft it and loop Legal). If useful, Kimberly and Marissa are copied — Kimberly will confirm billing/terms and Marissa will update marketplace copy to reflect any constraints.

Proposed next steps: Ben / procurement reply with PO contact + preferred trial length by EOD Friday; we’ll drop a DocuSign order-form draft and finalize marketplace hero copy once terms confirmed.

Appreciate it —

Procurement contact: procurement@acme-analytics.com (POs land there). AP / billing: ap-team@acme-analytics.com. Standard terms: we work on Net30 and will need invoice-based billing (we don’t do card for contract > $10k).

Also, our legal team may redline the standard order form; can you send the draft so Legal can review? Happy to run this quickly on our side if you can get the draft over today or tomorrow.

Hi Ben / Acme procurement —

Thanks for the quick reply and the AP contact. Below are concise answers you can paste into your internal system or provide to Legal for fast approval:

- Trial length: Redwood recommends 30 days for marketplace private offers. If you want a 60-day pilot we can accommodate, but that will trigger a brief co-sell enablement checklist (we'll note that in the onboarding timeline).
- Billing / PO: We accept PO -> Net30 invoicing for enterprise deals. Invoices will be sent to ap-team@acme-analytics.com; please include the PO number to avoid processing delays.
- SLA: For production pilots we can commit to a 4-hour business-hours critical response and a 24-hour standard response for severity 2; we'll add formal SLA language to the order form draft.
- Data handling: Redwood supports VPC and on-prem deployment options for regulated workloads. Default logging retention for hosted deployments is 30 days; if you need custom retention windows we can support them and will include options in the order form.
- Legal redlines: happy to accept redlines but will need to route any material changes through our Legal team; small administrative edits (PO, invoice info) we can accept in-line.

I attached a procurement snippet file with short suggested phrasing for the order form and marketplace page — feel free to drop these into your PO template. Aditya, can you coordinate final marketplace hero copy updates to reflect the VPC + retention bullets above? Marissa, once we have final wording I'll update the AWS listing content and push the copy to the private-offer flow.

Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
